name: AI Content Writer for GEO & Autopublish by TalkGenAI
author: talkgenai

sections.description:
SEO got you here. GEO takes you further.

Google isn’t the only one answering questions anymore. ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity are serving answers directly to your audience. TalkGenAI is an AI content writer for WordPress that plans, writes, and autopublishes articles structured so AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend you. Every article strengthens your E-E-A-T signals, for classic search and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

How it works: you create and manage articles in TalkGenAI Cloud (app.talkgen.ai). This plugin is the connector: it links your WordPress site to your account so articles arrive as drafts or live posts, with SEO fields filled in.

Content Plan and Autopilot

  • A content plan for your site – TalkGenAI reads your site and builds a plan of articles worth writing, then refreshes it on a regular schedule
  • Autopilot publishing – pick the days of the week and each article is written and published to WordPress on its date
  • Comparison, Alternatives and “Best X” formats – article types built to be cited by AI engines and to convert
  • Pillar-length articles (2,500+ words) on paid plans
  • Any language – English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, and more

AI Content Writer

Every article can include:

  • Internal links – TalkGenAI links new articles into your existing posts and pages, building topical authority
  • External links – cites authoritative sources that AI engines trust, checked so broken links are removed
  • FAQ section + JSON-LD schema – structured Q&A that AI engines can pull straight into answers
  • Your brand voice – learns your tone from your existing content and writes in it, instead of generic AI filler
  • Featured image – an AI image matched to the article topic; Pro and Scale can use images in your brand’s style
  • Meta description and focus keyphrase – written for both classic and AI-powered search

Refine any article in plain language (“make it more formal”, “add a section about pricing”), then push the update to a draft or to the live post.

Autopublish to WordPress

Stop copy-pasting from chat tools into the editor. Connect the plugin once, then work from TalkGenAI Cloud.

  • Publish or save as draft from Cloud – articles appear in WordPress with no copy and paste
  • Update live posts in place – refine an article and push the change to the existing URL, no duplicates
  • Refresh old posts and pages – pick a page Google shows but people rarely click, get a better version written from its own text and search queries, and replace it at the same URL after you approve. Page-builder pages are never replaced
  • SEO meta for major plugins – Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress title, description, and focus keyphrase
  • IndexNow – tells Bing and other IndexNow engines when posts are published or updated, so AI search that relies on Bing can find content faster
  • Categories, tags and parent pages – your organization settings applied on publish
  • Editor-aware formatting – Gutenberg blocks, or plain HTML for classic editors and page builders, chosen automatically

See What Is Working

  • Search Console results – clicks and rankings for the articles TalkGenAI wrote, from your own Google Search Console
  • AI visibility report (Pro and Scale) – the visits ChatGPT, Perplexity and other assistants send you, read from your own Google Analytics
  • Monthly results email – a short proof-of-traffic summary
  • Competitor agent (Scale) – watches the competitors you choose and drafts a counter-article idea when they publish

Use It From Claude, Cursor or Any MCP Client

TalkGenAI also runs as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so an AI assistant can work with your site for you. Add https://app.talkgen.ai/mcp as a connector in an MCP-compatible client such as Claude (claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Desktop), Cursor or VS Code, and sign in with your TalkGenAI account.

  • Ask in plain language – “plan articles for my site”, “write the next one”, “publish it as a draft”
  • Refresh what is not working – “find my pages with impressions but no clicks and refresh the first one”. The assistant asks you before it replaces any live page
  • Draft by default – the assistant saves a draft unless you explicitly say to publish live
  • Reads are free – check your plan, credits, drafts and reports at no cost. Writing, refining and planning use credits, as in the app

Setup steps per client are at docs.talkgen.ai. This is optional. The plugin works the same without it.

Works Beyond WordPress

The same TalkGenAI account also publishes to Webflow, Shopify, Wix and Framer.

Get Started in 4 Steps

  1. Install the plugin and open TalkGenAI > Settings
  2. Click Generate Connection Token
  3. In app.talkgen.ai open Integrations > Publish to WordPress > Add Site > Connect via Plugin and paste the token
  4. Start from your content plan, or describe an article. Publish as a draft, review it, and go live

Pricing

  • Free – a content plan and 3 articles on your real site, no credit card
  • Growth, $99/mo – 12 articles a month, 1 website, content plan refreshed quarterly, updates to live articles, monthly proof-of-traffic email
  • Pro, $199/mo – 16 articles a month, 1 website, AI visibility report, images in your brand’s style, content plan refreshed monthly
  • Scale, $299/mo – 20 articles a month, 1 website, everything in Pro plus the Competitor agent, AI-citation tracking and priority support
  • Enterprise – several websites, team seats, higher limits and done-for-you setup. Contact us for a quote

Billed monthly, cancel anytime. Plans and prices are managed in TalkGenAI Cloud and can change; see app.talkgen.ai/pricing for the current list.

External Services and Privacy

This plugin connects to external services. It does nothing with them until you connect your site to a TalkGenAI account.

1. TalkGenAI Cloud (https://app.talkgen.ai) – the service that writes and manages your articles.
Provider: TalkGenAI. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect: your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, and a connection token and site secret generated by the plugin, so Cloud can verify the site
  • While connected, whenever you publish, update, or on a daily resync: the URL, title and excerpt of your published posts and pages. TalkGenAI uses this list to suggest accurate internal links. Nothing is sent from drafts or private posts
  • When Cloud publishes an article to your site: the article content, images and SEO fields are received by the plugin. The plugin only accepts these requests with your site secret
  • When you ask TalkGenAI to refresh a specific page: that page’s title, content, SEO title and description, featured image status and page-builder markers are sent to Cloud, so it can check the page is safe to replace and write the new version. Only the published page you name is read, never a draft, private or password-protected post. Cloud keeps a copy of the old page for 30 days for support
  • Basic request data for security and rate limiting: IP address, timestamp and user ID of the WordPress admin who triggered an action

You can disconnect at any time with Reset Connection in TalkGenAI > Settings. This replaces the site secret, so the old one stops working immediately.

2. IndexNow (https://api.indexnow.org) – a public protocol used by Bing, Yandex and other search engines.
Provider: IndexNow. Terms and info

  • When a post is published or updated, the plugin sends that post’s URL, your domain, and a random key it generated for your site, so participating search engines can re-crawl it
  • No account is needed. This is on by default and switches itself off if another IndexNow plugin (Microsoft IndexNow, Rank Math, Yoast SEO) is active. To turn it off, return false from the talkgenai_indexnow_enabled filter or set the option talkgenai_indexnow_enabled to false

Data the plugin does NOT send: passwords or user credentials, your database, drafts or private content, or data from other plugins.

You are responsible for reviewing all generated articles before publishing. AI can make mistakes, so always verify facts, links, and claims.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for TalkGenAI or AI content writer
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Create a free account at app.talkgen.ai
  5. In TalkGenAI > Settings, click Generate Connection Token
  6. In TalkGenAI Cloud open Integrations > Publish to WordPress > Add Site > Connect via Plugin, paste the token, and save
  7. Create and publish articles from app.talkgen.ai. They appear on this site through the plugin connection

Until you connect, the plugin shows “Not connected yet”. That is expected on a new install.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Create an account at app.talkgen.ai
  6. Follow steps 5 to 7 above
sections.faq:
What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is the shift from traditional SEO to optimizing for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Instead of only ranking in Google, GEO makes sure your content is structured so AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend it. TalkGenAI articles are built that way by default.

Where do I create articles?

In TalkGenAI Cloud at app.talkgen.ai. This WordPress plugin is the connector: Settings, site connection, and publishing into your site. There is no article editor inside WordPress.

Does it autopublish to WordPress?

Yes. Connect your site in TalkGenAI > Settings, then publish or schedule from TalkGenAI Cloud, or let autopilot publish on the days you choose. Refined articles can update the live post in place so the URL stays the same. SEO meta is written for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress when those plugins are active.

Can I review articles before they go live?

Yes. Articles can be saved as drafts, and you press publish yourself. Drafts are the recommended setting when you start.

How do I get started?

Install the plugin, open TalkGenAI > Settings, click Generate Connection Token, then paste it in TalkGenAI Cloud under Integrations > Publish to WordPress > Add Site > Connect via Plugin. Watch the setup video for a quick walkthrough.

Is it really free?

The free plan gives you a content plan and 3 articles on your real site, no credit card required. When you want more, choose a paid plan.

Is the content optimized for SEO?

Yes. Each article uses a focus keyword in the title and headings, a clean H2/H3 structure, internal and external links, a meta description, and FAQ schema markup that search engines can read. Because TalkGenAI optimizes for both classic SEO and GEO, your content is positioned to rank in Google and to be cited by AI engines.

How do the internal and external links work?

When you connect, the plugin sends your published post and page titles, excerpts and URLs to TalkGenAI so it can pick relevant internal links. It also cites authoritative external sources and removes links that return errors.

What is Brand Voice?

Brand Voice learns from your existing content so new articles match your tone: sentence length, formality, and style. Articles are written in your voice instead of sounding like generic AI.

Does it generate images for articles?

Yes. Articles get an AI featured image matched to the topic. On Pro and Scale you can upload a few brand images so generated images follow your colors and look.

Can I change an article after it is generated?

Yes. Tell TalkGenAI what to change, such as “make it more formal” or “add more FAQ questions”. Then push the refined version to a draft or to the live post.

Can it refresh my old posts?

Yes. TalkGenAI finds pages that get Google impressions but few clicks (from your Search Console), writes an improved version from the page’s own text, and replaces it at the same URL. The URL, the subject, business facts and the page’s internal links are kept. Nothing changes until you approve, and pages built with a page builder (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and others), pages with forms or shortcodes, and the home page are refused. You can also change only the SEO title and meta description of any page. See the guide.

Can I use it from Claude or ChatGPT?

Yes, with MCP-compatible clients. Add https://app.talkgen.ai/mcp as a connector and sign in. It is tested with Claude. Other MCP clients that support remote servers should work too, and setup steps are at docs.talkgen.ai. The assistant saves drafts by default and publishes live only when you ask.

Does it work with other platforms or page builders?

The plugin picks the right format automatically for the block editor, Classic Editor, and page builders such as WPBakery. The same TalkGenAI account also publishes to Webflow, Shopify, Wix and Framer.

What happened to the calculators and widgets?

Interactive apps (calculators, timers, comparison tables) were an earlier feature. Widgets already on your pages keep working through the [talkgenai_app] shortcode. New installs focus on articles and autopublish.

2.7.12 – 2026-11-08

  • New: TalkGenAI can look up an existing page or post by its address, so it can refresh a page you choose and keep its URL. It reads the page’s title, text, SEO title and description, and whether the page was built with a page builder (Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, Breakdance, Brizy, Thrive Architect, SiteOrigin, Avada). Pages built with a page builder are never replaced.
  • New: TalkGenAI can update only the SEO title and meta description of an existing post or page (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress), without touching its content.
  • Improvement: When you refresh a page and ask for a new image, the new image replaces the page’s featured image. Before, an update always kept the old featured image.
  • Security: The page lookup only reads published posts and pages. Drafts, private and password-protected posts are never sent.

2.7.11 – 2026-11-07

  • Fix: A fresh install no longer shows “Connection needs attention” about an invalid legacy API key. With no API key and no connection token there is nothing to verify, so the plugin no longer contacts the server or raises that alert.
  • Improvement: Before you connect, the plugin now says “Not connected yet” and points to Generate Connection Token, instead of “TalkGenAI server is not configured”.
  • Fix: New installs now default to the production server (app.talkgen.ai). An empty saved server address also falls back to production.
  • Improvement: The WordPress.org listing now matches the current product: plans, autopilot, reports, external-service and privacy disclosure.

2.7.10 – 2026-10-22

  • Security: New “Reset Connection” button in TalkGenAI → Settings. It replaces this site’s connection secret, so the old secret stops working right away, and gives you a new token to reconnect. Your articles and settings are kept.

2.7.9 – 2026-10-15

  • Fix: Sites connected with a connection token no longer show “TalkGenAI server is not configured”. A token connection does not need an API key, so the warning was wrong and made working connections look broken.
  • Fix: The “Connection needs attention” notice about an old API key no longer appears once the site is connected with a connection token, and the stale notice is cleared automatically.

2.7.8 – 2026-08-29

  • Feature: Post Format now has an “Automatic” setting, and it is the new default. The plugin checks which editor your site actually uses — the WordPress block editor, or a classic editor such as WPBakery Page Builder or the Classic Editor plugin — and saves each article in the format that fits. Sites that edit with a page builder no longer have to find this setting and switch it by hand.
  • Improvement: The Settings screen now tells you which format was detected and why, so you can see the choice the plugin made. “Gutenberg blocks” and “Plain HTML” remain available if you would rather set it yourself; an existing choice is never overridden.

2.7.7 – 2026-07-25

  • Feature: All in One SEO (AIOSEO) and SEOPress support — the meta description, SEO title and focus keyphrase from TalkGenAI Cloud are now written to AIOSEO and SEOPress, alongside the existing Yoast SEO and Rank Math support. If your site uses any of these, generated articles now arrive fully optimised instead of with empty SEO fields.
  • Feature: Article tags — tags provided by TalkGenAI Cloud are now applied to the published post, improving on-site organisation and internal discovery.
  • Fix: Publishing now works on sites that lock down the WordPress REST API. Some hosts and security plugins block the REST API for all unauthenticated requests, which stopped TalkGenAI Cloud from publishing. The plugin now lets only its own secure endpoints through (still protected by your site key), so publishing succeeds without any manual firewall changes.
  • Improvement: WordPress.org listing repositioned around AI content writer, GEO, and autopublish (calculators/widgets demoted from the primary story).

External Services and Privacy

This plugin connects to external services. It does nothing with them until you connect your site to a TalkGenAI account.

1. TalkGenAI Cloud (https://app.talkgen.ai) – the service that writes and manages your articles.
Provider: TalkGenAI. Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect: your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, and a connection token and site secret generated by the plugin, so Cloud can verify the site
  • While connected, whenever you publish, update, or on a daily resync: the URL, title and excerpt of your published posts and pages. TalkGenAI uses this list to suggest accurate internal links. Nothing is sent from drafts or private posts
  • When Cloud publishes an article to your site: the article content, images and SEO fields are received by the plugin. The plugin only accepts these requests with your site secret
  • When you ask TalkGenAI to refresh a specific page: that page’s title, content, SEO title and description, featured image status and page-builder markers are sent to Cloud, so it can check the page is safe to replace and write the new version. Only the published page you name is read, never a draft, private or password-protected post. Cloud keeps a copy of the old page for 30 days for support
  • Basic request data for security and rate limiting: IP address, timestamp and user ID of the WordPress admin who triggered an action

You can disconnect at any time with Reset Connection in TalkGenAI > Settings. This replaces the site secret, so the old one stops working immediately.

2. IndexNow (https://api.indexnow.org) – a public protocol used by Bing, Yandex and other search engines.
Provider: IndexNow. Terms and info

  • When a post is published or updated, the plugin sends that post’s URL, your domain, and a random key it generated for your site, so participating search engines can re-crawl it
  • No account is needed. This is on by default and switches itself off if another IndexNow plugin (Microsoft IndexNow, Rank Math, Yoast SEO) is active. To turn it off, return false from the talkgenai_indexnow_enabled filter or set the option talkgenai_indexnow_enabled to false

Data the plugin does NOT send: passwords or user credentials, your database, drafts or private content, or data from other plugins.
